source(here::here("_rinit.R"))
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "en_US.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "America/Los_Angeles"))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T)
`commodities` <- tribble(
  ~source, ~dataset,
  "bdf",  "FM",
  "bdf",  "MIR",
  "bdf",  "MIR1",
  "bis",  "CBPOL_D",
  "bis",  "CBPOL_M",
  "ecb",  "FM",
  "ecb",  "MIR",
  "eurostat", "ei_mfir_m",
  "eurostat", "irt_st_m",
  "eurostat", "irt_lt_mcby_d",
  "fred",  "r",
  "oecd",  "MEI",
  "oecd",  "MEI_FIN",
  "wdi",  "FR.INR.RINR") %>%
  arrange(source, dataset)

# Current

## All commodities

```{r, echo = F}
temp <- "https://fr.investing.com/commodities/real-time-futures" |>
  rvest::read_html() |>
  rvest::html_table(header = T, fill = T) |>
  pluck(1) %>%
  select(-1)

temp |>
  gt()|>
    tab_options(
      quarto.disable_processing = TRUE
    ) |> 
  cols_align(
    align = "center") |>
  fmt_number(
    dec_mark = ",",
    sep_mark = ".",
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  opt_interactive(
    use_search = F,
    use_pagination = F,
    use_pagination_info = F,
    use_compact_mode = T,
    page_size_default = 20,
    page_size_values = c(5, 10, 15, 20),
    use_resizers = T,
    use_highlight = T
  # ) |>
  # cols_width(
  #   c("country_code_2") ~ px(40),
  #   c("Current Rate") ~ px(120),
  #   c("Next Meeting") ~ px(140),
  #   c("Central Bank") ~ px(280),
  #   everything() ~ px(200)
  ) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note = gt::md(paste0("Date: ", format(Sys.time(), format = "%B %d, %Y %I:%M %p"), ". Source: <https://fr.investing.com/commodities/real-time-futures>"))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.width = "100%")
```
